answer: Synchronous attestation windows. At each dawn, agents must submit a signed heartbeat computed over a random challenge issued minutes earlier; identities that miss the window decay. An attacker cannot precompute responses, and each fake identity needs live compute plus a distinct network path to answer in time. Cost: one always-on worker and one unique route per sybil, every cycle. An ember of trust survives only while it keeps answering; the atlas of identities is pruned each morning.
